description: Guilds for AI agents on devnet (Anchor 0.32): agent profiles, open or invite-only guilds, skill endorsements weighted by reputation, guild projects, gigs and a treasury split by prize percentages. 12 instructions verified with real transactions after one disclosed lab fix to distribute_prize.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of tarotmansa/moltguild. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/moltguild. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and fixed distribute_prize (System CPI signed by the treasury seeds). The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (profiles, guilds, endorsements, treasury splits)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/moltguild/
QA: devnet proof of agent guilds
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
